name: behemoth
note: Joint positions read off saved/models/big_zombie.pipeline.glb (Y up,
height ~1.9, feet at y=-0.95, head at y=0.95) via orthographic renders
and horizontal point-cloud slabs. The character faces +Z, so its right
hand is on -X (same convention as every other rig here).
A standard standing pose, not a raised-arm one -- both arms hang at the
sides. It is a bulkier build than the Gunslinger/Necromancer: torso and
arm cross-sections run noticeably wider, hence the wider torso radius.
One forearm (the gory one, -X/right side per the front render) hangs
slightly away from the torso rather than tucked in.
Bone names match necromancer.rig.json/gunslinger.rig.json so the same
pose-curve vocabulary drives this rig too.

joints.comment: Runs from the waist to the shoulder line (~y 0.65, where the point-cloud cross-section jumps wide). Greedy radius so the bulky torso doesn't lose mass to the thighs.
joints.name: torso

joints.comment: The gory forearm; hangs a little proud of the torso and reaches noticeably lower than the other hand (point-cloud x-extent on this side stays wide down to y~-0.6).
joints.name: armR_fore

joints.comment: The clean-sleeve forearm; hand ends around y~-0.35, well above the gory arm's reach.
joints.name: armL_fore

overrides.comment: Gut wound / entrails bulge: point-cloud slabs at belly height (y -0.15..0.15) show a distinct backward (-Z) protrusion past the general torso silhouette, which otherwise fragments across hips and both thighs. Force it onto the torso, the bone it actually hangs from.
